nodes.author: iMAM_MAHDi_313
nodes.text: @BRICSinfo @realDonaldTrump As of January 7, 2025, severe winter weather has caused significant disruptions to air travel, particularly in the United States and parts of Europe. On January 6, over 1,400 flights were canceled, and more than 1,000 were delayed across the U.S.,

nodes.author: iMAM_MAHDi_313
nodes.text: @BRICSinfo @realDonaldTrump with major airports in Washington, D.C., Baltimore, and Dallas-Fort Worth among the most affected.

nodes.author: iMAM_MAHDi_313
nodes.text: @BRICSinfo @realDonaldTrump In the U.K., adverse weather conditions, including snow and ice, have led to flight delays and cancellations at major airports. Dublin Airport remains operational but has warned passengers of potential schedule disruptions due to issues at U.K. airports.

nodes.author: iMAM_MAHDi_313
nodes.text: @BRICSinfo @realDonaldTrump While specific global figures are not readily available, these events highlight the widespread impact of the winter storm on air travel. Passengers are advised to check with their airlines for the latest information on flight statuses.

nodes.author: iMAM_MAHDi_313
nodes.text: @BRICSinfo @realDonaldTrump On January 7, 2025, a powerful 7.1 magnitude earthquake struck Tibet’s Shigatse region near Mount Everest, resulting in significant casualties and damage. Reports indicate at least 95 fatalities and 130 injuries, with over 1,000 homes damaged.

nodes.author: iMAM_MAHDi_313
nodes.text:
@BRICSinfo @realDonaldTrump The earthquake’s tremors were felt across western China, Nepal, and parts of India, causing widespread concern. 

In addition to the Tibet earthquake, several other significant seismic events occurred recently:

nodes.author: iMAM_MAHDi_313
nodes.text:
@BRICSinfo @realDonaldTrump •Iran: On January 6, 2025, a magnitude 5.4 earthquake struck near Fīrūzābād, Fars province, causing damage and prompting rescue operations. 
•Japan: On January 7, 2025, a magnitude 5.0 earthquake occurred near Hasaki, Chōshi-shi, Chiba, Japan, causing minor damages.

nodes.author: iMAM_MAHDi_313
nodes.text: @BRICSinfo @realDonaldTrump These events highlight the ongoing seismic activity worldwide, underscoring the importance of preparedness and timely response to natural disasters.
